en.headline: Midland forecasts 15 percent rise in Hong Kong home prices this year
en.dek: The agency said first-hand deals rebounded in August and expects primary transactions to jump 50 percent in the final quarter as buyers return.
body: Hong Kong home prices will finish 2026 about 15 percent higher than a year earlier, though still 16 percent below their 2021 peak, Midland Realty said after a briefing on Thursday.

Dave Ma Tai-yeung, chief executive of Midland Residential, said sentiment had improved as the market absorbed geopolitical and external economic uncertainty. New launches were accelerating and buyers were coming back, he said. The agency also argued that local banks were unlikely to follow any US Federal Reserve rate increase this year.

According to Midland's figures, first-hand residential transactions fell for two months to just over 800 units in June and July, then rebounded to 1,100 in August. Ma said primary deals in the fourth quarter would rise 50 percent from the previous quarter to 5,100 units, with second-hand transactions up 10 percent to 12,700. He said rents had been setting successive highs, leaving room for prices to catch up.

zh.headline: 美聯料今年樓價升15% 仍低於2021年高位一成六
zh.dek: 代理周四簡報指8月一手成交回升至1,100宗，預期第四季一手成交按季升五成，二手升一成。
body: 美聯物業周四舉行簡報會，預計2026年全年樓價較去年升約15%，但仍較2021年高位低16%。
美聯住宅行政總裁馬泰陽表示，市場逐步消化地緣政治及外圍經濟不明朗因素後，氛圍改善，新盤加快推出，買家亦逐步回流。該行並認為，即使美國聯儲局年內加息，本港銀行未必跟加。
美聯數據顯示，一手住宅成交連續兩個月下跌，6月及7月僅得800多宗，8月回升至1,100宗。馬泰陽預期，第四季一手成交按季升50%至5,100宗，二手升10%至12,700宗。他指租金屢創新高，樓價仍有追落後空間。
